run_megatron_tokenizer: run the MegatronDocumentTokenizer pipeline step to tokenize documents and write .bin and .idx files
create_megatron_tokenized_file: create a MegatronTokenizedFile instance to write tokenized documents with .bin and .idx output files
write_tokens_to_file: write tokenized document batches to a MegatronTokenizedFile and generate the index metadata
get_output_filename: get an output filename for a given rank and name for distributed tokenization
close_megatron_tokenized_file: close a MegatronTokenizedFile and finalize the .bin and .idx files with index metadata
